import io

Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless

"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame

# Set a clean style for the plot

# Create the scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))

# Use seaborn.scatterplot to visualize multiple dimensions

    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',

        row['brand'],
        fontsize=9,
